children: Overview
Azerbaijan copper and gold producer's H1 2026 revenue more than tripled yr/yr
Profit before tax for H1 2026 surged, driven by new Gilar and Demirli mines
Company lowered full-year gold production guidance due to lower recoveries at Gilar
Outlook
Company maintains 2026 copper production guidance at 20,000-25,000 tonnes
Company lowers 2026 gold production guidance to 26,000-30,000 ounces from 28,000-33,000 ounces
Company reduces 2026 copper AISC guidance to $6,000-$7,000 per tonne
Result Drivers
NEW MINES - Record copper production and financial growth driven by full-period output from Gilar and Demirli mines
OPERATIONAL UPGRADES - Commissioning of new flotation line and infrastructure improvements increased processing capacity and efficiency
LOWER GOLD RECOVERIES - Reduced full-year gold production guidance due to variability in Gilar ore
